headline: Chiefs defense faces a tough challenge
what_happened: D.Jones threw a short pass to J.Downs, who caught it and ran for six yards to get a first down, which is a new set of four tries for the offense.
who: D.Jones, J.Downs, L.Sneed, and N.Bolton were involved in the play.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for the Chiefs because it gives the other team more chances to score, and it increased their chances of winning the game by 7 percentage points.
